import os,json
exitp=r"E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused.exit"
logp=r"E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused.log"
def tail(path,n=32768):
    if not os.path.exists(path): return None
    size=os.path.getsize(path)
    with open(path,"rb") as f:
        f.seek(max(0,size-n))
        b=f.read()
    return b.decode("utf-8","replace")

 "log_size":os.path.getsize(logp) if os.path.exists(logp) else None,
 "log_tail":tail(logp)
},ensure_ascii=False))
